South Korea Affirms Intent to Aid US in Strait of Hormuz Passage

South Korea's top diplomats affirmed the nation's intent to assist the United States in ensuring free passage through the Strait of Hormuz. This affirmation followed South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's earlier statement ruling out the deployment of troops to the Strait. The discussions between the allied diplomats underscored ongoing cooperation between the two nations.
